cases: rejected overwrite preserves exact old rows and revisions
successful overwrite removes legacy stale rows and preserves unrelated rows
overwrite=false rejects duplicate and creates absent document
cancellation after acknowledged writes aborts and releases locks
competing writers expose complete first and second text/vector generations
limits: Synthetic documents and private ML fixtures; no production deployment, quality claim, source-revision ordering guarantee or rollback after ambiguous commit. Selected source hashes are not full runtime attestation.
